name: Messenger
short_desc: Encrypted text conversations with your peers, inside Wizard.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Private unified inbox with People, Groups, Telegram and optional Tinfoil translation. Matrix is internal plumbing; existing encrypted Marmot DMs remain available. Unified history is stored locally as plaintext; Telegram cloud chats are not end-to-end encrypted.

form_fields.label: Integration capability
form_fields.hint: Your Wizard generates this application-only capability. Use at least 32 characters; it is never pasted into the Messenger screen.

form_fields.label: Extra trusted Wizard web address (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty: Messenger accepts browser writes only from the address it is opened on. Add exact origins, comma-separated, only if your proxy rewrites the Host header.

form_fields.label: App path
form_fields.hint: The standard Wizard app path. Keep the trailing slash.
